executive_summary.headline: The social signal is a new interface for managing agents
executive_summary.body: Posts from Ethan Mollick and agent-workshop voices treat agents as workers that need permissions, physical controls, and review points. That is more useful than another prompt recipe.

executive_summary.headline: Platforms are building provenance and authenticity feedback loops
executive_summary.body: LinkedIn’s AI-slop reporting and TikTok’s labeling initiatives show that generated content now needs distribution controls and machine-readable evidence.
